summary: Overall 2-page sheet geometry matches 1707 April 2021 ENCS; targeted fixes needed for Seller/Buyer address left-border collision, TIN formatting, Page 2 Taxpayer's Name comb alignment, Schedule 2 No. of Shares alignment, and leaking internal JSON path in screen Part III.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Items 6A-6C and 7A-7C (Seller's and Buyer's Registered Address)
defects.what: First character of every address collides with / is clipped by the left vertical cell border.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Items 6A-6C and 7A-7C (Seller's and Buyer's Name)
defects.what: Name text sits flush against the left vertical border with no padding and no overflow clipping for very long names.
TIN prints flush against the left border as unformatted 14 digits ('00012345300000') without dashes.

defects.where: Page 2, header Taxpayer's Name comb box
defects.what: Name prints as plain proportional text crossing the vertical comb ticks instead of one character per comb slot.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 2 Continuation (No. of Shares rows A-D)
defects.what: Prints '0.00' left-aligned in the comb slots even when rows are empty, with the decimal point occupying a comb slot.
Displays internal developer note with raw repository path 'rules/forms/1707-v2021/fixtures/runtime-control-inventory-v796.json' directly in user-facing UI.

defects.where: Part IV Schedules 2 and 3 ('Schedule 2 add-more subtotal', 'Schedule 3 add-more subtotal')
defects.what: Internal jargon 'add-more subtotal' shown as user-facing labels.

defects.where: Not on the printed sheet — TIN branch code
defects.what: 5-digit branch code '00000' truncates to '000...' in the readonly TIN pill.

shared_changes_wanted: nsh/screens/form/: widen the 5-digit branch code box in the TIN control so '00000' does not truncate to '000...'.
